newsitem.title: UK: UK firms capital expenditure rose 5.0% in Q4.
newsitem.headline: UK firms capital expenditure rose 5.0% in Q4.

text.p: British manufacturers' spending on capital assets, including leased assets, rose by a provisional seasonally adjusted five percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 over the third quarter, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
But capital expenditure was nine percent lower than in the last quarter of 1995. Manufacturers' spending totalled 2.864 billion stg, up from 2.736 billion in the third quarter.
The provisional estimates of capital expenditure rose by two percent for services quarter-on-quarter and 74 percent for construction while other production stayed virtually unchanged.
Compared with the same quarter in 1995, other production fell by five percent while services expenditure rose by 10 percent and construction increased by 16 percent.
